title: Module 1 Readiness Studio
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting module 1 readiness studio to module 1 readiness map, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Audit a single artifact against all four Module 1 skills at once.
Mark each skill honestly as pass or gap based on what the artifact actually shows.
Resist the urge to check every box; flag real gaps instead of hiding them.
Convert each gap into a specific, targeted practice step.
